title: Tourist Season, 2003
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A tourist finds Gully's. Then twelve. Wood watches the corkboard fill with things that aren't his.

panels.composition: Gully's, August, a line out the door. Fleece, sun hats, kayaks on car roofs. GULLY pulling shots two at a time. WOOD on the stool, pushed to the end of the counter.

image.prompt: a small bait-and-espresso shop in August with a line of tourists in fleece and sun hats out the door, a young man in an apron pulling two shots at once, another crowded onto the end stool with a drawing pad, brush-pen black and white

panels.composition: The corkboard: Wood's rough now surrounded by a lost-cat flyer, a kayak rental card, a tide table, a photo of a tourist holding a crab.

image.prompt: close-up of a corkboard above a shop register: a pencil sketch surrounded by a lost-cat flyer, a kayak rental card, a tide table and a snapshot of a tourist holding a crab

panels.composition: A TOURIST, pointing at the rough.

image.prompt: a tourist pointing at a pencil sketch on a corkboard while the young man behind the counter keeps pouring and answers in one word

panels.composition: Wood on the stool, having heard all of it. Not looking up. Drawing the line out the door. The dog asleep on his foot.

image.prompt: a young man on a shop stool drawing the line of tourists out the door without looking up, a small dog asleep on his foot, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; xerox; black and white

notes: 'Regular.' 'Yeah.' Gully's two-word review is the strip's only one for years.
